text.p: Croatia beat Zagreb 2-1 (halftime 1-0) in the final of the Croatian Cup on Thursday.
Croatia - Igor Cvitanovic 30 penalty, Mark Viduka 65

CROATIA: Drazen Ladic, Dario Simic, Goran Juric, Srdjan Mladinic, Danijel Saric, Josip Gaspar (Vladimir Petrovic 75), Edin Mujcin, Damir Krznar, Silvio Maric, Mark Viduka (Stjepan Tomas 89), Igor Cvitanovic.

ZAGREB: Sandro Tomic, Nino Bule (Robert Regvar 80), Drazen Biskup, Mario Osibov, Jasenko Sabitovic, Sunai Kequi (Mario Cizmek 62), Marinko Galic, Vjekoslav Skrinjar, Ibrahim Duro, Elvis Scoria, Mate Baturina (Zeljko Sopic 45).
